remarks: Nestled in a tranquil setting on a private road, this expansive 2402 sq ft 4-bedroom, 3 3-full-bathroom home with a 2-car garage and a full attic offers a perfect blend of peace and potential. Set on 1.04 acres of land, with ancient trees and a serene pond, this residence is a true sanctuary. This location invites daily walks and peaceful moments in nature.  The light-filled interiors and high ceilings create an inviting atmosphere, ideally suited for both comfortable living and creative pursuits. With dedicated spaces for an artist's studio and or an office, the home caters perfectly to professional needs. There is incredible potential to update and customize to your taste.  The heart of the home is a custom European kitchen, expertly designed and fabricated in Europe and equipped with state-of-the-art appliances that cater to both culinary enthusiasts and everyday cooks. This space has been filled with joy and laughter, making it ideal for intimate family gatherings and lively entertaining.  With its unique European charm, this home is ready to welcome its next chapter! As is. The buyers agent is to verify all the information.
